title: First-view auto-expand logic untested — spec's test plan claims coverage that does not exist
evidence: client.gleam:2989: `let first_view = !set.contains(model.refcheck_auto_expanded, aid)`; 2990: `let summary_ids = case first_view {`; spec (OWNS #7): "client/test/components/reference_panel_test.gleam (NEW): ... expand/collapse toggling, first-view auto-expand, completed detail ..." — `grep -n refcheck client/test/client_test.gleam` → 0 matches; `grep -c 'auto_expand|first_view' client/test/components/reference_panel_test.gleam` → 0.
detail: No client.update test delivers ApiReturnedApplicationDetail with reference_calls, so the AC3 'expanded by default on first view, collapsed on return' branch is unpinned. The panel test file renders the component directly and cannot reach this update_inner logic.
recommended_fix: Add client.update tests: first detail delivery expands FormCompleted/ManualRecorded/Partial rows and inserts aid into refcheck_auto_expanded; a second delivery stays collapsed.

title: No update-level tests for UserToggledRefcheckRow/UserToggledRefcheckExplainer or the route-change reset; aria-expanded="true" and aria-controls never asserted
detail: The toggle flip (expanded↔collapsed), the explainer flip, and the BrowserChangedUrl reset of refcheck state are unpinned; only static render is covered. A11y contract's aria-expanded="true"/aria-controls sides never asserted.
recommended_fix: Add client.update tests for both toggle messages and the route reset; assert aria-expanded="true" and aria-controls in the component test.

title: Key-facts word map: spec-mandated total-match test absent — 1 of ~30 wire values asserted
evidence: copy.gleam:729: `pub fn refcheck_choice_word(value: String) -> String {`; 733: `"always_on_time" -> "Always on time"`; spec Testing standards: "Word-map tests: every wire value for the landlord set resolves (total match)."; test asserts only "Always on time" (`reference_received_state_test`); `grep -c 'Their landlord|In full|Not sure|As stated|Under a year|Ongoing' client/test/components/reference_panel_test.gleam` → 0 each.
detail: Only "Always on time" is pinned. A wrong or missing mapping for the other ~29 values (e.g. "prefer_not_to_say", "did_not_see", "still_held") would silently leak the raw wire value into the landlord-facing table.
recommended_fix: Add a total-match test enumerating every mapped wire value (yes→"Yes" ... as_stated→"As stated") plus the `_ -> value` passthrough.

title: Object-value renderer branches untested: ongoing / dont_remember / differs / stated / dont_know / different_amount_eur / as_stated
evidence: reference_panel.gleam:948 `fn render_period` ... `True -> copy.refcheck_month_year(from) <> " to " <> copy.refcheck_to_ongoing`; 968 `fn render_amount` ... `True -> copy.refcheck_dont_remember`; 980 `fn render_as_stated_text` ... `stated -> stated`; `grep -c 'ongoing|dont_remember|differs|dont_know|as_stated|different_amount' client/test/components/reference_panel_test.gleam` → 0.
detail: Fixtures exercise only {from,to} periods, amount_eur and absent values. The honesty branches — "to ongoing", "Don't remember", "As stated", differs/stated text, "Don't know" — render untested; a wrong word here would not be caught.
recommended_fix: Add one fixture per branch: ongoing period, dont_remember amount, differs and stated text, different_amount_eur and dont_know salary, as_stated:true.

title: Worth-knowing: 6 of 7 signal sentences untested; the 120s threshold boundary unpinned
evidence: reference_panel.gleam:1056: `Some(seconds) if seconds < 120 ->`; 1065: `Some(copy.refcheck_signal_same_device)`; 1068: `case signals.geo_vs_claimed_property {`; 1072: `case signals.voip_or_burner {`; 1076/1080/1084: duplicate/reused branches; test asserts only "Completed unusually fast (under 2 minutes)." plus the absent-case (completion_seconds 320).

evidence: reference_panel.gleam:417: `Scheduled -> #(copy.refcheck_pill_scheduled, pill_slate)`; 418: `Calling -> #(copy.refcheck_pill_calling, pill_navy)`; 419: `Completed -> #(copy.refcheck_pill_received, pill_teal)`; no_status_uses_red_test statuses list is `[Queued, Skipped, ContactInitiated, FormCompleted, ManualRecorded, Partial, AwaitingCorrection, Unreachable, Refused, Objected, Failed]` — no v2 trio; `grep -n 'Scheduled|Calling' client/test/components/reference_panel_test.gleam` → 0.

title: Malformed result JSON and result=None completed rows untested
evidence: reference_panel.gleam:667-672: `case call.result { None -> element.none() Some(text) -> case json.parse(text, parsed_result_decoder()) { Error(_) -> element.none() Ok(parsed) -> view_parsed_summary(call, app, parsed) } }`; every completed fixture uses a valid result string — no test feeds non-JSON.
detail: The defensive error path (unparseable stored result renders an empty expanded row) is untested, and no completed row without a result is exercised — the lens blind-spot heuristic for happy-path-only coverage.
recommended_fix: Add a test feeding a non-JSON result string (and one with result=None) asserting the expanded detail stays empty without crashing.

title: form_opened_at + reminder-batch combination untested (pill precedence and timeline insertion)
evidence: reference_panel.gleam:428: `case call.form_opened_at {` (in_flight_label); 551: `let has_next_reminder = list.length(batches) < 4`; form_opened_state_test uses `[invite_attempt(), sms_attempt()]` only; reminder_sent_state_test has 4 batches with form_opened_at: None (fixture default).
detail: The lens-named blind spot: with form_opened_at set AND ≥3 batches, the pill must show "Form opened" while the timeline shows invite + form-opened + nudge + reminder lines and no what-happens-next line. Neither precedence nor ordering is pinned.
recommended_fix: Add a fixture with form_opened_at plus 3+ attempt batches asserting the "Form opened" pill, timeline order, and absence of "Next reminder".

title: New server columns: nulls-when-empty unasserted; no integration wire assertion for form_opened_at/submitted_at
evidence: `wire |> string.contains("\"outcome\":null") |> should.be_true` (only outcome/result/display_disclaimer nulls asserted); encode_reference_call_malformed_attempts_test row has `form_opened_at: "",` / `submitted_at: "",` but asserts only `wire |> string.contains("\"attempts\":[]")`; `grep -n 'form_opened_at|submitted_at' server/test/integration/reference_detail_payload_integration_test.gleam` → 0 matches.
detail: The encoder's ""→None mapping for the two additive keys is never asserted, and the DB→wire path (COALESCE SQL select) for them has no integration assertion — the §8.1 integration test stops at the RC4.1 key set.
recommended_fix: Assert "form_opened_at":null / "submitted_at":null in the nullables test and add the two keys to the integration payload surface assertions.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: 31 panel tests cover the 11 v1 statuses + ManualRecorded, Off, pre-v1 hidden, sub-lines, not-answered, negative controls; `grep refcheck client/test/client_test.gleam` → 0; word map asserted: 1/~30; signal sentences: 1/7; renderer branches: ~2/9; aria-expanded="true"/aria-controls: 0.
detail: P0 100% (critical path pinned). P1 ≈ 80% (word map ~5%, auto-expand 0%). Overall across the 12 trace behaviours ≈ 73%: completed-summary extras ~72%, expand/collapse ~50%, auto-expand 0%, route reset 0%, integration keys missing → overall <80% = FAIL.
recommended_fix: Add client.update tests (auto-expand first/second view, row toggle, explainer, route reset), a total-match word-map test, per-branch signal/renderer fixtures, and server null + integration wire assertions to lift overall above 80%.
